intro: I'm Ravi Kumar, a Backend Developer with 2+ years of experience building production-ready backend applications, REST APIs and business solutions.
My work spans a PHP (Slim) CRM/ERP backend used daily in production, Laravel APIs, database optimisation, third-party integrations, and containerised deployments on AWS.
I focus on maintainable code, measurable performance improvements, reliable database workflows, and clean integrations with external services.

approachSubtitle: Working principles I apply to backend code.

principles.title: Maintainable architecture
principles.detail: Thin controllers, with business logic in services and data access in repositories, so modules stay easy to change.

principles.title: Reliable REST APIs
principles.detail: Predictable resources, input validation, consistent status codes and documented contracts.

principles.title: Performance from the data layer up
principles.detail: Find the slow path first, remove N+1 queries, use transactions where they matter, cache hot reads.

principles.title: Secure by default
principles.detail: Token authentication and role-based access checks on every protected route.

principles.title: Integrations that fit the workflow
principles.detail: Webhook handlers and API clients that bring external platforms into the core business process.

principles.title: Automated testing & delivery
principles.detail: Tests run in CI and deployments are scripted, so releases are repeatable.
